'''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a craft-able crafting resource, simply made from [[clay]] and [[water]]. They're used for a variety of crafting recipes, and 20 are required by [[Bishop]] to complete one of his many requests. They can be purchased from the [[potter]], and cannot be sold to any known vendor, except as [[trade office]] [[crate|package]]. They are a very important resource needed to create [[Polishing paste]] and [[Steel parts]], so creating them will not go to waste.
